Sect: Independent (Clan of the Crescent Moon)

The Assamites are a reclusive Middle Eastern clan infamous for hunting and drinking the blood of other vampires, treating diablerie and contract killing as both a trade and a sacred duty. They are organized around a strict internal hierarchy, with viziers handling diplomacy and scholarship while warriors carry out blood hunts for hire. Many outside the clan fear and shun them, assuming any Assamite present is sizing up the local Kindred for a future kill.

Disciplines: Celerity, Obfuscate, Quietus

Advantage: Assamites are renowned for their skill at silent killing and poison-craft, reflected in bonuses to assassination-related tasks and easy access to the secretive Quietus discipline.

Disadvantage: Elders of the clan are bound by an ancient curse that makes the taste of vampire blood addictive and physically punishing to resist, driving many toward diablerie even against their own better judgment.

Organization: A core caste of viziers manages clan business and external relations, while warriors and other ranks owe service and obedience up the chain of command. A notable antitribu offshoot exists within the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}.
